implementation.scope: Independent complete canonical primary DXF VisualStyle scalar/reference/source-envelope profiles and actual rooted original targets; selected original evidence only, without full extension/preset/recursive/live/output/semantic qualification.

sources.role: Primary VisualStyle field roles and distinct62/63/421 colors; extension grammar remains outside the documented primary inventory.
AcDbVisualStyle objects belong to ACAD_VISUALSTYLE in the named object dictionary. Configuring type/traits is an application operation, not scalar/profile acceptance.
VisualStyleDictionaryId identifies ACAD_VISUALSTYLE containing VisualStyle objects.
Shade modes distinguish VisualStyle and RenderPreset; numeric4/5 interpretation is already separately pinned by RPP-5fl.
Explicit visual-style/preset modes require their respective object types. Setter behavior does not prove foreign nonzero inactive-ID DXF semantics.

implementation: Add an independent converter-private raw profile with explicit code-to-role bindings, complete unique primary inventory, subclass/application/XDATA grammar, full coordinate/bracket closure and exact common handle roles. It does not use the shared payload decoder or its public code tables.

Bind raw values to each actual typed/raw model and property metadata observation, including description decoding under its owned source context, occurrence counts, separate colors, signed-zero doubles and native-only field/flag boundaries.

Require original identity record envelopes to contain exactly the captured raw scalar count for the VisualStyle, NOD and style dictionary. Existing raw callbacks omit ignored comments; refuse unknown per-field gaps instead of inventing raw-index correspondence.

Create an immutable source audit pinned to the actual rendering input audit and original structural dictionaries. Validate real NOD key/target and style-dictionary entry/target positions, matching parent owners and unambiguous names/membership. Preserve physical350/360 roles.

Add an actual rendering provider to the shared target registry and dependency graph without increasing the nine public resource families. Enable original entity/VIEW/VIEWPORT style348 and LAYOUT visual-style shade references only with qualified actual sources and named roots.

Census every physical rendering object so unsupported producers cannot disappear. Preserve known object type for parser-known aliases while withholding source/profile proof. Reject VisualStyle as a render-preset-mode target; full preset source qualification remains unavailable.

Bound source rows/spans/references, raw-text/codec workspaces and root/dictionary workspace before allocation. Preserve explicit limited/failure states and old-success rejection, immutable queries and corrected replay/finalization from original inputs.
Preserve ordinary tolerant reads and existing public model/facade/interface/source-view layouts and callbacks. No native DWG byte-layout or writer-admission change.

Every attempt is corrected and registry/dependencies rejoined.

development: Strict -Werror caught misleading indentation in the independent identity branch; fixed the statement layout without weakening warnings.

Initial authored LAYOUT set one physical333 alias and left the other zero. Existing source auditing correctly refused conflicting aliases; set both to the intended target and retain both physical uses.
Initial authored VIEW348 was appended after XDATA and correctly lost source qualification. Put the actual field in primary scope; preserve the refusal evidence.
Initial expected four target uses omitted the second physical LAYOUT shade alias; observed five uses are separately verified against source spans and both retained.
Add raw payload/codec workspace admission, not only per-field overhead. Source prerequisite failure/limits retain SourceNotReady and cannot reuse old success.
Apply actual ASCII versus binary semantic caret policy to description/root/key decoding; literal-wire controls exercise caret differences and Unicode escapes.

A development long-text selector was launched before its rebuild completed and used the older binary. Its output is retained as unqualified development evidence; later current-source owning/final runs are authoritative.

Final review found that the NOD and style dictionary require the same no-gap envelope prerequisite as VisualStyle before raw key/target indexes identify physical positions. Add both checks, independently inspect192 dictionary key/target byte spans and add six ignored-comment refusal/corrected-import controls. Preserve completed pre-correction builds/archives as development evidence; fresh frozen-source builds and packaging precede final runtime qualification.

The first final normal integration cohort passed101/102 and stopped at the existing LAYOUT fault13 control: explicit render-preset mode with a DICTIONARY target now correctly reports WrongKind, but the old control expected OriginalUnavailable. Correct only that exact expectation and preserve absent-mode unavailability plus all printed prior counters; retain the failed cohort and freeze/rebuild before final normal/ASan qualification.
